descriptionChirho: An Aramaic loanword (pitgam) denoting a spoken or written communication — a word, message, answer, or official decree. The semantic range is unified across all occurrences: whether rendered as 'word' (eng), 'mensaje' (spa), 'उत्तर/पत्र' (hin: answer/letter), 'كَلِمَة/رَدَّا' (arb: word/reply), '답변/대답' (kor: reply/answer), 'jibu/ujumbe' (swa: answer/message), or as 'the matter/sentence' (S129040) or 'the word' (S129042), the referent is always a verbal communication or pronouncement. The variation between 'word', 'matter', and 'message' reflects contextual nuance rather than distinct lexical senses; all point to a single semantic core of an authoritative or formal utterance.
